subject: Post-webinar: 'Serving LLMs at Scale' — attendee triage & replay distribution
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-webinar attendee cleanup + SDR routing (Serving LLMs at Scale)

Hi team,

Thanks for the great event yesterday — turnout was solid (~460 registrants, ~210 attendees). Attached is the raw export from EventPlatform with registration & attendance flags (webinar_attendees_20261005.csv). I need help with:  

1) Quick MQL triage: which flags should immediately become MQL? I propose: attended AND role in [Eng, ML/AI, Platform] OR request for pilot/demo in Q.
2) SDR routing: split by region/segment so SDRs can act tomorrow. Suggested routing rules inlined below.
3) Replay & deck distribution: confirm final replay URL/text for follow-up.

Suggested SDR routing (high level):
- US Enterprise (company size > 500 & attended) -> Senior SDR queue (tag: "event-enterprise")
- US SMB (<= 500 & attended) -> Growth SDR queue (tag: "event-smb")
- EU & APAC -> Local SDR + timezone-friendly outreach
- All who registered but didn't attend -> nurture sequence with replay and CTA to book a demo

Can Marissa confirm the MQL criteria and share the cleaned CSV with segment tags? Dev, can you confirm HubSpot properties we should set (source, event_campaign, lead_score_adjustment)?

Thanks — want to have routing done by EOD so SDRs can start outreach Tue morning.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: webinar_attendees_20261005.csv, talk-deck-serving-llms.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-webinar attendee cleanup + SDR routing (Serving LLMs at Scale)

Nice summary — added a couple of notes based on registration forms. My quick MQL rules (ready to export):

- MQL if: (attended == true AND (job_title contains "engineer" OR "ml" OR "data" OR "platform")) OR (attended == true AND asked_for_pilot == true)
- Auto-MQL score +20 for C-level who attended and requested follow-up
- Registered but no-show -> nurture: 2-email sequence with replay + 1 CTA to book

I've cleaned and appended tags: event_segment, event_queue (enterprise/smb/eu-apac), event_interest (inference/cost/ops). CSV with tags will be in Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/serving-llms-2026 (sheet: "Webinar - 2026-10-05 - cleaned")

Sending to Dev for HubSpot property names and to Jasmine for SDR split sign-off.

—Marissa
Marketing Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Post-webinar attendee cleanup + SDR routing (Serving LLMs at Scale)

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the sheet. HubSpot properties to set (exact names for import):
- hs_event_campaign = "serving-llms-2026-10-05"
- hs_event_segment = values: "enterprise","smb","eu-apac"
- lifecyclestage = "lead" -> some will be promoted to "marketing qualified lead" based on your rules
- lead_source_detail = "webinar:serving-llms"

Routing notes for import:
- field: event_queue -> workflow 1 maps "enterprise" -> owner assignment to group "SDR-Sr-US"
- field: event_queue -> workflow 2 maps "smb" -> owner assignment to group "SDR-Growth-US"
- EU & APAC -> assign to "SDR-Intl" and set local timezone outreach task for 9am local

I'll run the import at 18:00 PT after we get final confirmation from Jasmine. I'll attach the HubSpot import template (attached: hubspot_import_template.csv).

Dev
